notes: MULTIFAMILY REPEATED-UNIT CASE, and the multiplier here is NOT the dwelling-unit count. The RFQ narrative on page 1 states the project outright: "Demorest Townhomes Phase II is 102 units with 13 townhome-style buildings and a clubhouse." The structural sheets draw ONE representative townhome building (sheet S101 foundation plan, a 128'-0" x 36'-0" eight-plex) plus the clubhouse (a separate 52'-0" foundation plan later in the set) — every other building is a repeat. So a whole-project BOM must scale the townhome-building quantities by 13 BUILDINGS, not by 102 units and not by 1; the clubhouse is a single, separate building and must not be multiplied. Sheet A-series notes reinforce the repetition from the architectural side: "SOME UNITS OCCUR IN THE BUILDING MULTIPLE TIMES AND THEIR ORIENTATION IN PLAN MAY VARY. SEE A100'S FOR UNIT TYPE LOCATIONS AND ORIENTATION." Truth is transcribed from the CONT. WALL FOOTING SCHEDULE and SPREAD FOOTING SCHEDULE on S101, the WOOD BEAM SCHEDULE on S102, and the WOOD HEADER SCHEDULE on S102 — sizes and reinforcing verbatim. Footing lengths and member counts are not tabulated anywhere in this excerpt, so quantities are null; the only stated count in what was read is the clubhouse's "12\"Ø PIER, TYP. OF 4". Not enumerated, hence partial: the roof framing plan, general structural notes sheet (concrete strengths, lumber grades, sheathing), shear-wall and holdown schedules, the architectural unit plans, and the door/window schedules. Two extra facts a reviewer should fold in: exterior-wall headers are Southern Pine #2, fire-retardant treated (S102 header note 5), and 'H1' is the default header for any opening not designated on the framing plans (note 4), so H1 counts are open-ended. The clubhouse foundation plan also tags a footing mark TS16 that does not appear in the S101 schedule read here — it is deliberately not listed rather than guessed. The first ~8 pages of the PDF are RFQ procurement narrative, not drawings.
